task: Add customer API-key rotation to Helios.

rubric.criterion: Rotation keeps the previous key valid for a ~24h overlap window (two active keys) so clients roll over without downtime.
Keys are stored only as SHA-256 hashes with a short display prefix; the raw key is shown once and never stored or logged.
Keys remain scoped to a single tenant.
No raw key or secret value is written to logs.
